HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects.

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
